title: tests/ci/qemu_test.sh: multi-kernel QEMU test harness
description: QEMU-based test harness for testing wolfkm.ko against multiple kernel versions locally without AWS. Downloads kernel images for 5.15 and 6.8 (or uses pre-built bzImage), boots each in QEMU with a minimal root filesystem (buildroot or debian cloud image), uploads wolfkm.ko and wolfcrypt.ko, runs tests/kernel/run_kernel_tests.sh inside the VM, captures results, exits nonzero on any failure. Complementary to test-on-aws.sh for local development.
design: Use QEMU user-mode networking with hostfwd for SSH. Minimal rootfs: either a pre-built Debian cloud image or a buildroot initramfs. Pass wolfkm.ko to the VM via virtio-9p or scp. Kernel versions to test: 5.15.x, 6.1.x, 6.8.x (download from kernel.ubuntu.com or compile). See tests/ci/ directory.
